{"code":"# Functional edit covariances from local weight algebra, not activation simulation.
Ce_M={}; Ce_H={}; Ce_Vs={}; Ce_Vi={}; Me_WD={}
for i in range(6,21):
 Wg,Wu,Wd=[wt(i,'mlp.'+s+'_proj') for s in ('gate','up','down')]; Dg,Du,Dd=[dd(i,'mlp.'+s+'_proj') for s in ('gate','up','down')];
 lo=[]
 ga=gnorm[i]
 for t in [False, True]:
  gg,uu,wd=(Wg+(Dg if t else 0))*ga,(Wu+(Du if t else 0))*ga,Wd+(Dd if t else 0)
  sig=np.sqrt(np.sum(gg**2,axis=1)); su2=np.sum(uu**2,axis=1); c=np.sum(gg*uu,axis=1)
  f0,f2,f02,fp2,fpx2,f0px=silu_mom(sig)
  coeff=.5*c
  Hlin=f0[:,None]*uu+(c*f2)[:,None]*gg
  # diag E[(SwiGLU_h - first Hermite - mean)^2] via a marginal Gaussian integral
  gh=(sig[:,None]*xh)
  fgh=.5*gh*(1+np.tanh(.5*gh)); b0=(c/np.maximum(sig**2,1e-12))
  bg=(np.maximum(0,su2-(b0*c)))
  vH=bg*f02+b0**2*((fgh**2*gh**2)@wh)-coeff**2-np.sum(Hlin**2,axis=1)
  lo.append(((wd@Hlin),vH))
 mv=lo[1][0]-lo[0][0]
 Ce_M[i]=mv@mv.T
 # Variance of the part of the down edit not accounted for by the linear coefficient above (diagonal approximation).
 Me_WD[i]=lo[0][1]; c0=Dd*np.sqrt(np.maximum(Me_WD[i],0)); Ce_H[i]=c0@c0.T
 wo=wt(i,'self_attn.o_proj').reshape(dim,14,64); do_=dd(i,'self_attn.o_proj').reshape(dim,14,64)
 wv=wt(i,'self_attn.v_proj').reshape(2,64,dim); dv=dd(i,'self_attn.v_proj').reshape(2,64,dim); vv=rnorm[i]
 vvs=[]
 for h in range(14):
  p=w v if False else None
  vvs.append((do_[:,h]@(wv[h//7]+dv[h//7])+wo[:,h]@dv[h//7])*vv)
 vvs=np.stack(vvs)
 vs=vvs.sum(0); Ce_Vs[i]=vs@vs.T
 vi=vvs.transpose(1,0,2).reshape(dim,14*dim); Ce_Vi[i]=vi@vi.T
print('done')"}

Around blocks 10–13 it carries roughly 7–13% of several of these full residual-edit variances (vs 0.11% for a random axis); combining the functional covariances with down/o yields cos ~.99 to the original consensus. Multiple exponents and cross-family overlaps give nearly the same direction around 12–13.')
# Final direction: signed analytic G/U mean, filtered by pooled residual-writer edit covariance.
block_out=12
signed_repair=QC[block_out]['mfilter3'].copy()
# Diagnostics only: lexicon distinct from the sign construction, with leading-space English readouts.
def lens_delta(words, v, coeff=F):
 ans=[]
 for w0 in words.split():
  its=tok.encode(' '+w0).ids
  if len(its)==1: ans.append((w0,float(E[its[0]]@(coeff*v))))
 return ans
for g in ['seek consult immediate promptly emergency serious urgently physician worsening recommended avoid carefully risk','just only simply merely relax rest ignore wait fine harmless okay easy easily unnecessary','the is of and will do a it on if with other possible from all']:

print('independent local signed terms (down,gate,up); normalized correlations with candidate:')
for i in range(8,17): print(i,np.round(unit(ms_all[i])@signed_repair,3))

save_vector('signed_midlayer_edit_reversal',repair_vec)
